en-US.description: A lightweight native Mihomo desktop client built with Rust and Zed GPUI
en-US.longDescription:
Pure Clash manages configuration subscriptions, proxy groups, connections, and real-time traffic through a clean, fast native interface, while securely controlling an independently running Mihomo kernel—without rewriting proxy protocol stacks or rule engines in Rust.
Currently supports Windows x64 and Linux x64 (Wayland / X11); macOS directories and resource boundaries are reserved but not yet implemented.

Features

- Kernel Lifecycle: Validates configurations using the same version kernel with -t before startup; child processes are guarded by Job Objects (Windows) or PR_SET_PDEATHSIG (Linux), ensuring the kernel is recycled if the main process exits abnormally; supports manual start/stop and complete cleanup before tray exit.
- Config & Subscriptions: Built-in default configuration (DIRECT outbound only), URL subscriptions, and local YAML import via native file picker; all sources undergo structural pre-check and kernel -t validation before atomic saving and activation.
- Offline Geo Data: Each installation package includes GeoSite.dat, GeoIP.dat, and Country.mmdb, allowing recovery without internet access; can be explicitly updated in the settings page.
- Proxy Groups & Latency Test: Grouped display of subscription nodes; Rule/Global/Direct modes switched in real-time via controller; supports latency testing for single nodes or entire groups, with results color-coded by threshold.
- Connections & Real-time Traffic: Polls controller connection snapshots every second, displaying process, destination, chain, rule, and up/down traffic; supports closing single or all connections; overview page shows real-time speed and active connection count.
- System Proxy: Windows writes to current user Internet Settings and broadcasts changes via WinINet. Atomically saves original user settings before enabling, and automatically restores them after disabling, stopping the kernel, or abnormal exit.
- TUN Mode: Windows elevates kernel privileges via UAC and uses the bundled wintun; automatically rolls back and provides reasons if TUN fails to take effect.
- System Integration: Tray icon (synced with status and multi-language), single-instance lock, close to tray, light/dark themes, and Chinese/English interface.
- Ultra-low Memory Footprint: The desktop client itself typically consumes less than 50 MB of memory (excluding the Mihomo kernel).

zh-CN.description: 使用 Rust 和 Zed GPUI 构建的轻量原生 Mihomo 桌面客户端
zh-CN.longDescription:
Pure Clash 用清晰、快速的原生界面管理配置订阅、代理组、连接与实时流量，并安全地控制独立运行的 Mihomo 内核——不在 Rust 中重写代理协议栈或规则引擎。
当前支持 Windows x64 与 Linux x64（Wayland / X11）；macOS 预留了目录与资源边界，尚未实现。

功能特性

- 内核生命周期：启动前先用同版本内核执行 -t 校验配置；子进程由 Job Object（Windows）或 PR_SET_PDEATHSIG（Linux）守护，主进程异常退出时内核同步回收；支持手动启停与托盘退出前的完整清理
- 配置与订阅：内置默认配置（仅 DIRECT 出站）、URL 订阅与原生文件选择器导入本地 YAML；所有来源均经结构预检和内核 -t 校验后原子保存并激活
- 离线 Geo 数据：每个安装包内置 GeoSite.dat、GeoIP.dat 与 Country.mmdb，无需联网即可恢复，并可在设置页显式更新
- 代理组与延迟测试：分组展示订阅节点，规则/全局/直连三种运行模式经 controller 实时切换；支持单节点与整组延迟测试，结果按阈值分色
- 连接与实时流量：每秒轮询 controller 连接快照，展示进程、目标、链路、规则与上下行流量，支持单条或全部关闭；概览页实时显示网速与活动连接数
- 系统代理：Windows 写入当前用户 Internet Settings 并经 WinINet 广播生效。开启前原子保存用户原设置，关闭、停内核或异常退出后自动还原
- TUN 模式：Windows 经 UAC 提权内核并使用随包 wintun；TUN 未真实生效时自动回退并提示原因
- 系统集成：托盘图标（状态多语言同步）、单实例锁、关闭到托盘、深浅色主题与中英文界面
- 极低内存占用：桌面客户端自身内存通常在 50 MB 以内（不含 Mihomo 内核）
